# PLAN — iteration 3

## Current state assessment

Iteration 2 is the verified, timing-feasible incumbent at 0.329 ns register-to-register WNS, with 0.076 ns hold slack. The seed keeps the product delay chains and carry-save reduction, then finishes with a 32-bit `s5 + c5` carry-propagate adder before the registered output. Since both incumbent and candidate must remain timing-feasible, this iteration must strictly improve register-to-register WNS beyond 0.329 ns to replace it. Preserve the one-cycle behavior and `// @latency 1`.

## Hypothesis

Replacing the final 32-bit carry chain with a segmented carry-select adder may shorten the product-register-to-`y_out` path, at the cost of additional LUT logic.

## Instruction for generator

Change only the final `wire signed [31:0] total = s5 + c5;` reduction into a 32-bit segmented carry-select adder: compute fixed-width chunk sums for both carry-in values in parallel, then select each chunk using the preceding chunk’s carry. Preserve modulo-32-bit result semantics, all signed parameter behavior, the product delay chains, reset behavior, registered `y_out`, and the existing latency annotation. Keep the carry-save tree and compare routed register-to-register WNS and hold slack against the incumbent; retain the candidate only if it passes all gates and improves the stated objective.
